info.title: TRIMME API
info.description: Public, customer, shop and admin API for the TRIMME salon and barber booking marketplace.

get.summary: API name, version and current server time (UTC).
A stored image (JPEG, PNG or WebP). Public and immutable: a new upload always gets a new id.
The signed-in user with roles and permissions.
The signed-in shop user's shop, from the session (never from the request).
Discovery: shops near a point (or in a city) with text, category, open-now, verified, bookable-today and price filters, sorted by distance, rating or earliest slot.
Categories offered by the shops around a point, with the lowest price among them (never a global price).
The best-rated professionals of the listed shops around a point (stored ratings only; no contact data).
Listed shops, their active professionals and the average of their stored ratings.
Cities and districts with listed shops (manual location) and the default map centre.
Listed shops and their active professionals' slugs, for sitemap.xml.
An active shop's public profile, rating, prices and hours. No professional or customer contact data.
Live part of the shop page: open now, online booking state and each professional's next free time.
The shop's own professionals, read-only and without contact data.
Active professionals of an active shop. No contact data.
An active professional of an active shop: profile, rating and the services they do. No contact data.
The professional's earliest bookable starts (first day with any, within a week) for their shortest service.

post.summary: Adds a service to a shop with the shop's own price and duration, and the shop's barbers who do it (audited).

get.summary: Active service categories, in display order.
An active shop's published services (active, not archived, not hidden).
An active shop's published packages whose every service is available.
The professionals who can do a walk-in of this service or package: free now, next free time and the day's free starts.

put.summary: Sets one of the shop's own professionals' weekly hours (never their profile).

post.summary: Books an offered slot (Idempotency-Key required; a replay returns the same booking). 409 booking.slot_unavailable when the time was taken.

get.summary: The business day's KPIs, next bookings, each professional's load and the last seven days by hour (s-overview).
One to seven business days: each professional's working time, breaks and time off, and the bookings (s-calendar).
Published reviews of an active shop, or of one of its professionals, newest first, with the rating summary.

post.summary: Reviews the customer's own completed booking once, within the review window; published with the first name and initial only.

get.summary: Shop subscriptions by status (most urgent end date first), with counts over every shop.
The signed-in shop's own subscription and renewal history (read-only).
The signed-in account's own in-app notifications (customers: their bookings; admins: operational alerts), newest first.
How many of the account's notifications are unread.

post.summary: Marks one of the account's notifications read.
Marks every notification of the account read.

get.summary: Meta's subscription check: echoes hub.challenge when hub.verify_token matches the configured token.

post.summary: Message status updates from Meta (sent, delivered, read, failed); the signature is verified before the body is read.

get.summary: Platform KPIs for today or the last 7 or 30 days, the 14-day trend, popular categories and top shops (SQL aggregates, platform calendar).
Issues the CSRF cookie and returns its value for the X-CSRF-Token header.

post.summary: Sends a 6-digit sign-in code to a Saudi mobile number (customers).
Verifies the code, signs the customer in (creating the account if new) and sets the session cookies.
Saves a new customer's name, language and terms acceptance.
Shop and admin staff sign in with email and password.
Emails a password-reset link to a staff account. Always returns 202.
Sets a new staff password from an emailed link and signs out every device.
Creates a staff account from an emailed invitation and signs it in.
Rotates the refresh cookie and re-issues the access cookie.
Ends the current session and clears the session cookies.

get.summary: The signed-in user's active sessions (devices).

delete.summary: Signs out one of the user's own sessions.

post.summary: Signs out every other device; the current session stays signed in.

get.summary: The permission catalogue.
Roles with their granted permissions.

post.summary: Creates a platform-admin role with no permissions (audited).
Emails a platform-admin invitation for the given admin role.
Emails a ShopOwner or ShopStaff invitation for one shop (audited).

get.summary: Customers, newest first, searchable by name only; booking count, upcoming, last and next booking. No contact data.
A customer's profile with the mobile masked and their booking figures.

post.summary: Returns the customer's full mobile once, for support; a reason of at least 5 characters is required and the view is audited (never cached).

put.summary: Renames a role created by an admin; seed roles keep their names (audited).

delete.summary: Deletes a role created by an admin that nobody holds (audited).

put.summary: Sets an editable admin role's permissions. Managed roles 409; SuperAdmin permissions never; only permissions you hold (403 role.escalation). Audited.

get.summary: Platform staff with their roles (search by name or email; filter by role).

put.summary: Replaces a staff member's admin roles. Not your own; SuperAdmin only by a SuperAdmin; never the last SuperAdmin; no role with permissions you lack. Audited.

post.summary: Blocks a staff account; its sessions stop on the next request (audited).
Unblocks a staff account (audited).
Creates a shop in Draft status.

get.summary: Shops, newest first, with search (name, slug, district) and status filter (paged).
One shop with its profile, location and shop-edit policy.

put.summary: Edits the public profile and verification (audited, optimistic concurrency).

post.summary: Activates a draft or suspended shop (audited).
Suspends a shop; its users lose access to shop data immediately (audited).

put.summary: Sets the confirmed map point and address (audited).
Sets which profile fields the shop may edit itself (audited).
Replaces the logo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB; audited).
Replaces the cover image (1600×900 recommended; audited).

post.summary: Adds a gallery image (up to 12; audited).

get.summary: The shop's own profile and the admin's edit policy. Not available while suspended.

put.summary: Edits the fields the admin policy opens to the shop; a locked field that changes answers 403.
Replaces the logo, if the policy allows.

delete.summary: Removes the logo, if the policy allows.

put.summary: Replaces the cover image, if the policy allows.

delete.summary: Removes the cover image, if the policy allows.

post.summary: Adds a gallery image, if the policy allows.

delete.summary: Removes one of the shop's gallery images, if the policy allows.

put.summary: Sets the shop's map point, if the admin policy opens the location to the shop.

get.summary: Whether the shop's online booking is paused (D-013).

post.summary: Stops new online bookings and availability; confirmed appointments stay (audited).
Takes online bookings again (audited).

get.summary: Address and district search for the location picker (server-side provider, cached).
The address at a map point, for the picker's confirmation card.
Address and district search for the location picker (server-side provider, cached).
The address at a map point, for the picker's confirmation card.

post.summary: Creates a professional in exactly one shop (audited).

get.summary: Professionals with shop, status and search filters (paged). Numbers are masked.
One professional. The WhatsApp number is masked.

put.summary: Edits the profile (audited, optimistic concurrency). The shop cannot change.

post.summary: Hides the professional from booking (audited).
Makes a disabled professional active again (audited).

put.summary: Sets or corrects the WhatsApp number and the notification toggle (audited, number never logged).

post.summary: Returns the full number once, for a stated reason (audited; never cached).

put.summary: Replaces the photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB; audited).

get.summary: The shop's own services in display order (archived ones on request).

post.summary: Creates a service with the shop's own name, price and duration.

get.summary: One of the shop's own services; another shop's id is 404.

put.summary: Edits the shop's own service (optimistic concurrency).

delete.summary: Deletes a service nothing uses yet; otherwise 409 service.in_use (archive instead).

post.summary: Turns the service on.
Turns the service off.
Retires the service for good; history keeps it.

put.summary: Sets the display order from the full list of non-archived services.

get.summary: The shop's own packages, with whether each is currently bookable.

post.summary: Creates a package of the shop's own services.

get.summary: One of the shop's own packages.

put.summary: Edits the package and its items (optimistic concurrency).

post.summary: Turns the package on.
Turns the package off.
Retires the package for good.

put.summary: Sets the display order from the full list of non-archived packages.

get.summary: All categories with how many active shop services use each.

post.summary: Creates a category (no price or duration: those are the shops').

put.summary: Edits a category (audited).

post.summary: Offers the category again.
Stops offering the category for new services; existing ones keep it.

get.summary: Shop services across the platform, each with its shop's own price and duration (paged).
One shop service.

put.summary: Edits a shop's service and who does it, with the shop's own price and duration (audited).

post.summary: Hides a service from customers (reason required) or shows it again (audited).

put.summary: Support correction of one shop service, with a reason; audited before → after.

get.summary: Shop packages across the platform (paged).

post.summary: Hides a package from customers (reason required) or shows it again (audited).

get.summary: The professional's own shop's services, with that shop's prices, and which are assigned.

put.summary: Replaces the assigned services; only the professional's own shop's services (audited).

get.summary: Opening hours, professionals' hours, current and upcoming closures, breaks and time off.

put.summary: Replaces the weekly opening hours; applies from now on, bookings are never cancelled.

post.summary: Closes the shop on whole days (no slots on those business days).

put.summary: Edits a closure (optimistic concurrency).

post.summary: Upcoming bookings the closure would overlap (nothing is saved or cancelled).
Adds a weekly or one-off break for one professional or everyone.

put.summary: Edits a break (optimistic concurrency).

post.summary: Upcoming bookings (within the booking horizon) the break would overlap.
Records a professional's time off (vacation, sick leave…).

put.summary: Edits time off (same professional; optimistic concurrency).

post.summary: Upcoming bookings of the professional the time off would overlap.

get.summary: Bookable slot counts per local date (default: 14 days from today, at most 31) for a service, several services booked together (serviceIds) or a package, one professional or any.
Only genuinely bookable starts of one local date, with the professionals free for each (any professional when none is given).
What a scanned code opens: an active shop, or one of its active professionals. Unknown or switched-off codes are 404.

post.summary: Counts a scan (no IP address, no tracking; a reload reuses the visit) and sets the first-party attribution cookie for later bookings.

get.summary: Every shop's QR codes (active first, newest first) with each code's scans and credited bookings over the period: from–to, or the last `days` days (default 30).

post.summary: Creates a unique code for a shop, or for one of its active professionals (audited).

get.summary: One code with its target, printed URL and the last 30 days' figures.

post.summary: Switches a code off: scanning it shows «not found»; its scans and bookings are kept (audited).
Switches a code back on (audited).

get.summary: The code as PNG (size = pixels per module, 4–40), SVG or PDF (70 mm, vector).
Scans, credited bookings and scan-to-booking conversion over a period of days: from–to, or the last `days` days (default 30; at most 366), per shop.
The shop's own QR codes with their scans and bookings over the period (default: the last 30 days).
One of the shop's own codes; another shop's id is 404.
One of the shop's own codes as PNG, SVG or PDF.
The customer's own bookings: upcoming (soonest first) or past (latest first).
One of the customer's own bookings with the actions still allowed; another customer's id is 404.

post.summary: Cancels the customer's booking until the cancellation cutoff (D-015).
Moves the booking to another offered slot until the cutoff (Idempotency-Key required).

get.summary: Dates the booking can move to (same professional and duration) with their free starts; the booking's own time does not block it.
The free starts on one date the booking can move to.
The booking as an iCalendar event (add to calendar).
The shop's bookings by local date range, any of the given statuses and professional; search by customer name or reference only. Counts per status chip.
One of the shop's bookings with its history and internal notes; never the customer's phone.

post.summary: Records a walk-in with the same collision checks as online bookings (R-BKG-07).
Moves the booking along the state machine (D-016); invalid transitions answer 409.
Adds an internal note (never shown to the customer).

get.summary: Bookings across shops (paged; latest first unless sort=asc): shop, any of several statuses, time range, channel, customer, professional; search by customer name or reference only. Status chip counts.
One booking with its history and the shop's internal notes (read-only).

post.summary: Moves the booking along the state machine on the shop's behalf; a reason is required (audited). Invalid transitions answer 409.
Cancels on the shop's behalf with a reason (audited); the same as a transition to CancelledByShop.

get.summary: The professionals a booking may move to and the free starts on one date for its duration (its own time does not block it).

post.summary: Moves a pending or confirmed booking to a free start (the desk's collision rules, not in the past) with a reason; Idempotency-Key required; audited. 409 booking.slot_unavailable when the time was taken.

get.summary: Reviews for moderation: the queue (published with a report, a low rating or a phone number in the text), published, hidden or all; with counts.

post.summary: Reports a published review to the moderators with a reason (it stays published; audited).
Hides a review with a reason: it leaves the public pages and the rating totals (audited; never deleted).
Publishes a hidden review again, or clears a report on a published one (audited).
Sends the review's shop an in-app message about it (audited without the text).

get.summary: The customer's saved shops and professionals, most recently saved first; ones discovery no longer shows are left out of the cards.

put.summary: Saves a shop (idempotent).
Saves an active professional of a listed shop (idempotent).

get.summary: Every plan in display order, with its current price and full price history.

post.summary: Creates a draft plan (SuperAdmin).

get.summary: One plan with its price history.

put.summary: Edits a plan's details (SuperAdmin; optimistic concurrency). Existing subscriptions keep their snapshots.

post.summary: Offers the plan (it needs a price).
Stops offering the plan; existing subscriptions may still renew on it.
Retires the plan for good; history keeps it.

put.summary: Sets the display order of every non-archived plan (SuperAdmin).

get.summary: The plan's price versions, newest first.

post.summary: Adds a price version from a date (today or later). It applies only to periods starting on or after that date.

get.summary: A shop's subscription: status, current period, every renewal and override.

post.summary: Starts the shop's subscription on a published plan; the price in force on the start date is recorded.
Records a renewal period (no payment in v1); earlier periods never change.
SuperAdmin shop-specific price and/or end date for the period in force, with a reason (audited).
Suspends the subscription (reason required). Existing bookings are not touched.
Lifts a suspension.

get.summary: Every template slot (event × audience × locale) with its active version number and text, and whether it has a draft.
A template slot with its version history (newest first) and the placeholders its audience may use.

put.summary: Creates the draft or replaces its text; validated against the placeholder whitelist. Active and archived versions never change.

post.summary: Copies an earlier version's text into the draft (it still needs activation).
Makes the draft the active version (the previous one is archived). Only future messages use it; audited.
Validates text and renders it with fixed sample data (no real booking or customer). Nothing is saved.
Sends a version rendered with sample data to a number the admin typed and confirmed; a registered customer's number is refused. Audited without the number.

get.summary: The WhatsApp dispatch log, newest first: masked recipient, template version, status, attempts and error; counts per status and the last 24 hours' delivery rate.
A dispatch with its rendered text (until the retention period ends), its content hash and the template version that rendered it.

post.summary: Queues a failed dispatch for one more attempt (audited).

get.summary: A booking's WhatsApp dispatches and its reminder jobs (audience, due time, status).
The shop's in-app notifications, newest first (names, items and times; never a customer phone number).
How many of the shop's notifications are unread.

post.summary: Marks one of the shop's notifications read.
Marks every notification of the shop read.

get.summary: The platform settings: booking policy, reminders, subscription enforcement, map defaults.

put.summary: Edits the platform settings (audited, optimistic concurrency).

get.summary: The audit trail, newest first (keyset cursor; at most 100 per page). Entries hold no personal data and are never edited.
Every recorded action code and entity type, for the filters.

AddPlanPriceRequest.description: A new price version in the platform currency, effective from today or a later date.

AdminBookingDetailResponse.description: One booking for an admin: the shop's view, its history and internal notes (read-only here).

AdminBookingListResponse.description: A page of bookings across shops, with the status chips' counts (every filter but the status applied).

AdminBookingResponse.description: A booking in the admin views (the shop's view plus the shop and the customer's id; no contact data).

AdminCustomerResponse.description: A customer's profile for support: `PhoneMasked` only (for example `+966 5•• ••• •12`) and their booking figures.

AdminOverviewResponse.description:
`Days`: The KPI window: today only (1), or the last 7 or 30 days including today.
        `AppointmentsToday`: Today's bookings (the whole platform day) without cancellations.
        `Period`: Bookings that started from the window's first day until now.
        `Previous`: The same elapsed length immediately before, for the deltas.
        `Trend`: The last 14 days, oldest first, every day present.

AdminProfessionalListItem.description: A professional in the admin list.

AdminProfessionalResponse.description:
A professional as the platform admin edits it. Guid AdminProfessionalResponse.ShopId is read-only: it is fixed at creation and no
request can change it (R-NEG-01).

AdminRescheduleBookingRequest.description: An admin reschedule: the new start, optionally another eligible professional, a reason (≥ 5 characters) and the version read.

AdminRescheduleOptionsResponse.description:
Free starts on one shop-local date for the booking's duration and the chosen professional (the booking's own time does
not block it), and the professionals it may move to: the active ones assigned to the booked item, or only its own
professional when the item is no longer offered.

AdminReviewResponse.description: A review as moderators see it: the public name and text, the shop and professional, the flags and the moderation state.

AdminServiceRequest.description:
An admin's service for a shop (D-127): the shop's own name, price and duration, and the shop's barbers who do it.
On an edit, `ProfessionalIds` null keeps them and `Version` is the one read.

AdminShopDetailResponse.description: A shop with its full profile, location and shop-edit policy, as the platform admin edits it.

AdminShopResponse.description: A shop in the admin list.

AdminShopSubscriptionResponse.description:
A shop's subscription for admins. `Exists` is false (status `None`) until a plan is assigned;
`NextStart` is the default start date of the next assignment or renewal.

AdminWhatsAppResponse.description: The WhatsApp settings an admin sees. The number itself is only ever masked here (reveal is a separate, audited action).

AffectedBookingResponse.description: An upcoming booking that a new break, time off or closure would overlap. Never carries a phone number.

AssignSubscriptionRequest.description:
Starts a shop's subscription. `StartDate` defaults to today (it cannot be in the future); the end follows the
plan's interval. A custom `DurationDays`, a past start or an explicit `Price` is a SuperAdmin override: it
needs `SuperAdmin.Subscriptions.Override`, the explicit total `Price` and a `Reason` (D-081).

AuditEntryResponse.description:
`ActorName`: The acting account's display name (never an email or phone); null for the system.
        `ShopNameAr`: The shop the action concerns, when it concerns one.

AuditFacetsResponse.description: The values the filters can take: every action code and entity type recorded so far.

AuditPageResponse.description: `NextCursor`: Pass it back as `cursor` for the next (older) page; null on the last page.

AvailabilitySlotResponse.description:
A bookable start (D-009: only genuinely bookable slots are returned). `LocalTime` is `HH:mm` in the
shop's time zone; `ProfessionalIds` are every professional free for the whole item (D-012 candidates).

AvailableDatesResponse.description: Every date from `From` to `To` with its number of bookable slots (0 = none), for the date strip.

AvailableSlotsResponse.description:
Slots of one local date. When the shop takes no online bookings right now (paused, subscription not in force…),
`Bookable` is false, `BlockedReason` says why and there are no slots (D-013, D-078).

BookingItemResponse.description: What was booked, as it was at booking time (R-BKG-01).

BookingTransitionRequest.description: Confirmed, Arrived, Completed, NoShow or CancelledByShop (reason required). Send the version read.

BreakRequest.description:
A break for one professional or everyone (`ProfessionalId` null): weekly on `Weekdays`, or once on
`Date` (exactly one of the two). Minutes from local midnight, within the day, on 5-minute steps.

BreakResponse.description: A break; `ProfessionalId` null means everyone. Weekly (weekdays) or once (date).

CalendarBookingResponse.description: A booking block on the calendar: the customer's name and the booked item, never a phone number.

CalendarLaneResponse.description: A professional's lane on a business day: working time, breaks and time off (the calendar shades the rest).

ClosureRequest.description: Closed days, inclusive. `Version` is needed to edit.

ConflictPreviewResponse.description:
Bookings the change would overlap. Nothing is cancelled or messaged automatically (DV-S22): the shop sees them and
decides.

ContactShopRequest.description: A message to the review's shop (5–500 characters), shown in its notifications.

CreateBookingRequest.description:
A customer's online booking of a published service, several services booked together (`ServiceIds`, one
professional back to back) or a package: services or a package, never both. Without a professional the server picks a
free one (D-012). The start must be one of the offered slots.

CreatePlanRequest.description: A new plan (Draft). `InitialPrice`, when given, becomes price version 1 from today.

CreateProfessionalRequest.description: The one shop is chosen here, at creation, and can never be changed afterwards (D-011).

CreateQrCodeRequest.description: A shop code (no professional) or a code for one of the shop's active professionals, with an optional label.

CreateShopPackageRequest.description: A package of 2–10 of the shop's own services, with its own price and total duration.

CreateShopServiceRequest.description: A new service of the signed-in shop. Price in SAR (≤ 2 decimals); duration a multiple of 5 minutes.

CustomerBookingResponse.description:
A booking as its customer sees it, with what they may still do: cancel or reschedule until the cutoff (D-015), review a
completed visit until `ReviewDeadline`. `ReviewRating` is the stars they gave, once reviewed.

CustomerContactResponse.description: The customer's full mobile in E.164, returned once to an authorized admin (never cached, never logged).

DayPeriod.description: Where a slot sits in the day (D-009 groups the slot grid by period).

DiscoveryAreaResponse.description: A district with listed shops, and where it is (the average of its shops), for manual location (DV-A21).

DiscoveryAreasResponse.description: The districts customers can pick, and the platform's default map centre.

DiscoveryOfferResponse.description: The offer a search matched, or the one a price pin shows (the shop's own name, price and duration).

DiscoveryStatsResponse.description: Real platform totals for the landing page; the web hides any that is zero (no fabricated figures).

DispatchDetailResponse.description: A dispatch with the rendered text (until the retention period ends) and its hash.

DispatchResponse.description: A dispatch as the log lists it: masked recipient only, never the number.

DispatchStats.description: Messages recorded in the last 24 hours and the share delivered or read, in percent (one decimal).

FavoriteProfessionalResponse.description: A saved professional with their shop; never a phone or WhatsApp number (R-PRO-02).

FavoriteShopResponse.description: A saved shop, as its discovery card shows it.

FavoritesResponse.description:
The customer's favorites, most recently saved first. Only shops and professionals discovery would show are listed;
`ShopIds` and `ProfessionalIds` are everything saved (to fill the heart buttons).

GeocodedPlace.description: An address search or reverse-geocoding result.

HoursIntervalDto.description:
One weekly interval: minutes from the weekday's local midnight. `EndMinute` may pass 1440 when the window
closes after midnight (21:00–02:00 is 1260–1560).

LocationSource.description: How the location point was chosen in the picker.

MeResponse.description:
The signed-in user (`GET /api/v1/me`). `UserType` is `Customer`, `ShopUser` or
`PlatformAdmin`. A customer sees only their own number, masked. `ShopId` is set for shop users from
Phase 05. `ProfileComplete` is false until a customer has given a name and accepted the terms.

MessageAudience.description: Who a message is for (spec §16): customers and professionals have independent templates.

MessageEvent.description:
The booking lifecycle events that send a WhatsApp message (spec §16, D-109). Customers get all five; professionals get
confirmed (their new-booking alert), rescheduled, cancelled and the reminder, never the pending request.

ModerateReviewRequest.description: A reason (5–300 characters) for a report or a hide; send the version read.

ModerationRequest.description: Hide needs a reason (audited); unhide does not.

ModerationState.description: Platform moderation of a shop's service or package (DV-S02). A hidden item is never published.

MyReviewResponse.description: The review the customer just published (shown to them; the public list shows first name + initial only).

NextSlotResponse.description: A bookable start: the instant and its local time (`HH:mm`, shop time zone).

NotificationResponse.description: A notification as the web app renders it: the kind and its parameters (names, ISO times, counts), never a phone number.

OnlineBookingStateResponse.description:
Whether the shop takes online bookings right now (s-hours pause card, D-013). While paused the shop gets no new
online bookings and no availability; confirmed appointments stay, and walk-ins still work.

OpeningHoursRequest.description: The whole week of opening hours. Send the `Version` read (null only before the first save); stale → 409.

OpeningHoursResponse.description: The shop's weekly opening hours. `Version` is null until the shop saves its hours for the first time.

OpeningIntervalResponse.description: A weekly opening window: minutes from the weekday's local midnight; the end may pass midnight (up to 24 h later).

OtpChallengeResponse.description: Response to an OTP request. The code is never returned.

OverrideServiceRequest.description: Support correction of one shop service. A reason is required and the change is audited.

OverrideSubscriptionRequest.description: SuperAdmin override of the period in force: a shop-specific price and/or end date, with a reason.

OverviewCategory.description: Bookings of one platform category (services are shop-owned, so they are never grouped by a global service, DV-S02).

OverviewPeriod.description:
`Total`: Bookings that started in the window, cancellations included (the rates' denominator).
        `CompletionRate`: Completed ÷ total, in percent with one decimal; 0 when there were none.

PagedResponseOfAdminCustomerListItem.description: The paged envelope every list endpoint returns.

PagedResponseOfAdminPackageListItem.description: The paged envelope every list endpoint returns.

PagedResponseOfAdminProfessionalListItem.description: The paged envelope every list endpoint returns.

PagedResponseOfAdminServiceListItem.description: The paged envelope every list endpoint returns.

PagedResponseOfAdminShopResponse.description: The paged envelope every list endpoint returns.

PagedResponseOfCustomerBookingResponse.description: The paged envelope every list endpoint returns.

PagedResponseOfPublicReviewResponse.description: The paged envelope every list endpoint returns.

PagedResponseOfStaffAccountResponse.description: The paged envelope every list endpoint returns.

PauseOnlineBookingRequest.description: Pausing online booking; the optional reason is the shop's own note (≤ 300 characters).

PaymentStatus.description: Payment seam (R-BKG-10): v1 takes no payments, so every booking is PaymentStatus.NotApplicable.

PlanOrderRequest.description: Every non-archived plan, in the new order.

PlanResponse.description:
A plan as SuperAdmin manages it. `CurrentPrice` is the version in force today (platform calendar) and
`UpcomingPrice` the next scheduled one; `Prices` is the full history, newest first.

PlanStatus.description: Draft (being prepared) → Published (offered) → Inactive (not offered, may return) → Archived (final).

PopularCategoryResponse.description: A platform category offered nearby, with the lowest price among those shops (DV-S11, D-025: never a global price).

PreviewTemplateRequest.description: Text and buttons to validate and render with sample data (nothing is saved).

PriceRangeResponse.description: The lowest and highest pin price of the results before the price filter (the price slider's range).

ProfessionalAvailabilityResponse.description: When a professional can next be booked online (today or tomorrow, their shortest bookable service).

ProfessionalHoursResponse.description: A professional's weekly hours as the shop manages them (no contact data).

bookings.description: Their bookings that day (cancellations left out).

availableMinutes.description: Their working time that day outside breaks and time off.

working.description: They have working time that day.

onLeave.description: Time off takes all of their working time that day.

ProfessionalNextSlotsResponse.description:
The professional's earliest bookable starts (the design's "earliest times available today"): the first day with any,
within a week, for their shortest online-bookable offer. Not cached. `Bookable` is false, with the reason, when
the shop takes no online bookings.

ProfessionalServicesResponse.description: The professional's own shop's services (with that shop's prices) and which are assigned (DV-S04).

PublicPackageResponse.description:
A published package: itself and every item service are available. `ProfessionalIds` are the professionals
assigned to every one of its services (who can perform the whole package).

PublicProfessionalDetailResponse.description:
A professional's public page (`/shops/{slug}/professionals/{proSlug}`): profile, their shop, rating and the
published services they do. Never carries a phone or WhatsApp number (R-PRO-02). Cached (D-093).

PublicProfessionalOfferResponse.description: A service or package the professional does, with the shop's own price and duration.

PublicProfessionalResponse.description:
A professional on the public shop page, with their published rating (zero reviews = no rating). Never carries a phone
or WhatsApp number (R-PRO-02).

PublicReviewResponse.description:
A published review as the public sees it (D-017): the author's first name and surname initial, never the full name
or any contact data (DV-S15). `ItemNameAr/En` is the booked service or package (the design links reviews to a
service).

PublicServiceResponse.description:
A published service: active, not archived, not hidden by the platform. `NameEn` may be null (D-070).
`ProfessionalIds` are the professionals assigned to it (the booking wizard shows the active ones among them).

PublicShopLocationResponse.description: Where a customer finds the shop: the confirmed point and the address, without who confirmed it.

PublicShopResponse.description:
A published shop's public profile (`GET /public/shops/{slug}`). Only active shops are published. The phone is the
shop's own business number; professional and customer numbers are never part of a public contract (R-PRO-02). The
response is cached (D-093), so nothing in it depends on the time of day: open status and availability come from
`/status`. `ListedInDiscovery` is false while the subscription hides the shop (the page is then not indexed).

PublicShopStatusResponse.description:
The time-sensitive part of the shop page (not cached): open now, closes at or opens next, whether online booking is
open (and why not: `shop.paused`, `subscription.expired`…), and each active professional's next free time.

PublishReviewRequest.description: Publishing needs only the version read.

QrAnalyticsResponse.description:
The analytics of a period of local days [`From`, `To`] (platform time zone). Bookings count when they were
made in the period; a scan counts as converted when any booking was credited to it.

QrCodeResponse.description: A code with its target's names, the printed URL and its figures over the chosen period.

QrFigures.description: Scans, the bookings they brought, and the share of scans that led to a booking (percent, one decimal, ≤ 100).

QrTargetResponse.description:
What a scanned code opens. A professional code whose professional is no longer active opens the shop instead, so a
sticker on a mirror never leads to a dead page.

QrTargetType.description: What a code opens (c-qr print notes): the shop page, or one professional's page «for the chair mirror».

RatingSummaryResponse.description: Average and count, and the number of reviews per star (index 0 = one star … 4 = five stars).

RecordQrVisitRequest.description: The landing page's language, so the scan log can say which language visitors read.

RenderedButton.description: A button as rendered into a dispatch: its label and the URL the platform built.

RenewSubscriptionRequest.description:
Records a renewal; the plan defaults to the current one and the start to the day after the current end (or today
after a lapse). Custom durations, past starts and explicit prices follow the same SuperAdmin rule as activation.

ReorderRequest.description: Every non-archived item of the shop, in the new order.

RescheduleBookingRequest.description: Moves the booking to another offered start (and optionally another eligible professional). Send the version read.

RescheduleDatesResponse.description:
Dates the customer can move their booking to (same professional and duration), with the number of free starts on each.
`Bookable` is false with the reason while the shop takes no online bookings (reschedule is then refused, D-087).

RevealedWhatsAppResponse.description: The full number, returned once per audited reveal. Never cached.

ReviewFlag.description: Why a review is in the moderation queue (D-102).

ReviewTag.description: What the customer liked (design c-rate "ما الذي أعجبك؟"): a fixed list, translated by the clients.

SaveProfessionalFavoriteRequest.description: The professional's shop (a professional belongs to exactly one shop).

SaveTemplateDraftRequest.description: The draft's text, buttons and optional Meta template name; send the template version read.

ScheduleEntryState.description: Whether a closure or time off is in force now or still ahead (past entries are not listed).

SetProfessionalWhatsAppRequest.description:
Sets, corrects or removes (null) the WhatsApp number (E.164 or a Saudi national format), and the notification
toggle. With `KeepCurrentNumber` only the toggle changes, so an admin never needs to see the number to do that.

ShopBookingCounts.description: How many bookings each status chip would list (every filter but the status applied).

ShopBookingListResponse.description: A page of the shop's bookings, with the status chips' counts.

ShopBookingResponse.description:
A booking as the shop sees it: the customer's name, never a phone number (R-NEG-04). `AllowedTransitions` is
what the UI may offer (DV-S08); `ViaQr` marks an online booking credited to a QR scan (the design's «رمز QR» source);
`OutsideSchedule` flags an active booking that no longer fits the professional's
hours, breaks, time off or closures (DV-S22) — nothing is cancelled automatically.

ShopCalendarResponse.description: Business days `From`…`To` (at most seven) with lanes per professional and their bookings (s-calendar).

ShopCategory.description: Kind of business, shown on the public page and used by discovery filters (Phase 11).

ShopLocationResponse.description: The confirmed shop entrance. Coordinates are WGS 84 decimal degrees.

total.description: The day's bookings, cancellations left out.

previousDayTotal.description: The same for the day before (the design's "vs yesterday").

pendingUpcoming.description: Bookings still waiting for the shop's confirmation, from now on (any day).

cancelled.description: The day's cancellations (by the customer or the shop).

freeMinutes.description: Bookable minutes left that day: each professional's available time minus their booked time.

ShopOverviewResponse.description:
The operational overview of one business day (s-overview): KPIs, what comes next, each professional's load and the
last seven days by starting hour (local time; cancellations left out).

ShopPackageResponse.description: A shop's own package. `IsBookable` is false while any item service is off, archived or hidden.

ShopProfessionalResponse.description:
A professional as the shop sees it (read-only: the shop cannot create, edit or move professionals, spec §7).
Shop-facing contract: no contact data of any kind.

ShopProfileField.description: Profile areas an admin can open to or lock from the shop (DV-S16). Verification and slug are never shop-editable.

ShopProfileResponse.description:
The signed-in shop user's own shop (`GET /api/v1/shop/me`). Shop-facing contract: it must never carry customer
contact data (R-NEG-04). The status is reported even while suspended, so the dashboard can explain it.

ShopQrCodesResponse.description: The shop's codes with the period's figures (the last 30 days by default).

ShopRatingResponse.description: The shop's published rating (from stored reviews only; zero reviews means no rating to show).

ShopScheduleResponse.description: Everything the s-hours screen shows, for the signed-in shop.

ShopSearchItemResponse.description:
A shop in discovery results. `PinPrice` is the matched offer's price, else the shop's lowest (the map pin and
the "from" price, mapRules #1). `DistanceKm` is set only when the search has a location. `EarliestSlotAt` is
the first bookable start today or tomorrow (null when there is none, or when the shop was not probed). No phone numbers.

ShopServiceResponse.description:
A shop's own service as the shop manages it. Shop-facing contract: no customer data. `NameEn` may be null;
clients show the Arabic name instead (D-070).

ShopSubscriptionResponse.description: The signed-in shop's own subscription, read-only (renewals go through the platform admins).

SignInResponse.description:
Result of a successful sign-in; the session cookies are set on the response. `IsNewUser` is true when the OTP
verification (or an invitation) created the account.

SitemapResponse.description: Every shop listed in discovery, with its active professionals' slugs (the sitemap, R-WEB-10).

SubmitReviewRequest.description: Stars 1–5, optional tags from the fixed list, optional comment (≤ 1000 characters).

SubscriptionCounts.description: Counts over every shop (a shop without a subscription counts as `None`).

SubscriptionEnforcement.description: What happens to a shop whose platform subscription is not in force (D-014).

SubscriptionPeriodResponse.description: One recorded period with the plan name and price as they were charged (never recomputed).

SubscriptionStatus.description: Spec §15 statuses. `None` is a shop that has never had a subscription.

TemplateButtonTarget.description: What a template button opens (the URL is built by the platform, never typed by the admin).

TemplateDetailResponse.description: A template slot with its whole version history (newest first) and the placeholders its audience may use.

TemplatePreviewResponse.description: The rendered sample (no real booking or customer), the issues found, and the placeholders the text uses.

TemplateVersionActionRequest.description: Send the template version read (optimistic concurrency).

TestSendRequest.description:
A test send: the version (default the draft, else the active one), a mobile number typed by the admin (never prefilled)
and the explicit confirmation that it is a test recipient.

TimeOffRequest.description:
Time off from `StartDate` to `EndDate` (inclusive, shop-local). Without minutes it covers whole days;
otherwise it starts at `StartMinute` of the first day and ends at `EndMinute` of the last.

TimeOffResponse.description:
Time off. `StartDate`/`EndDate` are the shop-local days it covers (inclusive); the minutes are null for an
all-day entry.

TopProfessionalResponse.description: A highly rated professional of a listed shop (only stored ratings; no contact data).

UpdateOwnShopProfileRequest.description: The shop's own edit. Send the whole form: fields locked by the admin policy must keep their current value.

UpdatePlanRequest.description: Edits a plan's details; prices change only through a new price version.

UpdatePlatformSettingsRequest.description: The editable platform settings; a stale `Version` answers 409.

UpdateProfessionalRequest.description: Profile edit. There is deliberately no shop field: a professional cannot be moved to another shop.

UpdateShopProfileRequest.description:
The admin's profile edit. `Version` is the value the client read; a stale value answers 409
`resource.concurrency_conflict`.

UpdateShopServiceRequest.description: Edit of the shop's own service; a stale `Version` answers 409.

WalkInOptionsResponse.description: Walk-in choices for a service or package on one shop-local date (s-walkin).

WalkInProfessionalResponse.description:
One professional who can do the walk-in: free right now (whole duration, D-035), the next free start on the day's
grid, and every free start that day.

WalkInRequest.description:
A walk-in (D-035): without `StartsAt` it starts now and is marked Arrived; otherwise it is Confirmed. The
customer's name only. An `Idempotency-Key` header is honoured when sent.

WhatsAppVerification.description: Delivery state of the WhatsApp number, set by the notification worker (Phase 15).

WorkingHoursRequest.description: A professional's hours: follow the shop's opening hours, or their own weekly intervals.
